commands.name: run

options.name: --buildConfiguration
options.description: Configuration used for the temporary-suppression  builds - Release or Debug. Use Debug when a Release-only target, such as an  obfuscator, prevents the build from completing. (default Release)

options.name: --buildFile
options.description: Solution (.sln) or project (.csproj) file to build.  Required when multiple .sln files exist in --projectPath.

options.name: --buildProperty
options.description: MSBuild property forwarded to the  temporary-suppression builds as -p:Name=Value. Repeatable. Use it to switch off  a conditioned target, e.g. --buildProperty SkipObfuscation=true.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Preview mode: log what would be created or updated  without writing any files. Skips the temporary-suppression build loop. (default  false)

options.name: --failOnChanges
options.description: Exit with a non-zero code when any file was created or updated. Combine with --dry-run to gate CI on "coding rules are  current" without writing anything. (default false)

options.name: --forceNugetRefresh
options.description: Ask the ATC API to re-read package versions from  nuget.org instead of serving its 12-hour cache. Use when a just-published  version is not being picked up. (default false)

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit a machine-readable JSON summary on stdout  (per-file outcomes, package bumps, props drift) instead of log output. Useful  for CI.

options.name: --optionsPath
options.description: Path to an atc-coding-rules-updater.json options file. Defaults to the one in --projectPath if present.

options.name: --organizationName
options.description: Organization name to substitute into the  <OrganizationName> placeholder in Directory.Build.props.

options.name: --projectPath
options.description: Path to the project root directory (defaults to the  current directory). Pass '.' for the current directory.

options.name: --projectTarget
options.description: Sets the ProjectTarget. Valid values are: DotNetCore,  DotNet5, DotNet6, DotNet7, DotNet8, DotNet9, DotNet10 (default), DotNet11

options.name: --repositoryName
options.description: Repository name to substitute into the  <RepositoryName> placeholder in Directory.Build.props.

options.name: --temporarySuppressionAsExcel
options.description: Write the temporary-suppressions file as Excel (.xlsx) instead of plain text. (default false)

options.name: --temporarySuppressionPath
options.description: Optional output directory for the  temporary-suppressions file. When set, the .editorconfig is not modified.

options.name: --useLatestMinorNugetVersion
options.description: Bump PackageReferences in Directory.Build.props to the latest version within the same major version. (default true)

options.name: --useTemporarySuppressions
options.description: Build the project, collect analyzer errors, and write  temporary suppressions. Appended to .editorconfig unless  --temporarySuppressionPath is set. (default false)

options.description: Use verbose for more debug/trace information
